decisions.reason: GA4 is now Google's only analytics standard, so demand for the plugin is likely to grow, and keeping it on the market costs little.
Google shut down Universal Analytics in 2023, and the remaining 360 version ends in 2024, so the uncertainty about this plugin's value has resolved and the option is worthless.
A retail system interface is a low-cost option whose value for connecting shops to retail systems is still uncertain but plausible, so it is worth keeping open.
The SEO relaunch service draws on the firm's existing consulting skills, has its own dedicated page, costs little to maintain, and fits steady demand from shop relaunches.
